name: Super Flying Vroom Vroom
description:
About This Game

Cars don't fly. Ours do.

Every ramp blasts you high above the track. Carry your momentum, control your flight, and stick the landing to keep your run alive. Mess it up and you're done. Nail it and you just gained precious tenths. Easy to understand. Brutally hard to master.

Solo

Learn every corner, find the perfect line, and hunt for the ultimate time. Instant restart and a full replay system let you analyze every run. Your best ghost is always right there, pushing you to go faster.

Multiplayer

Race your friends head-to-head or climb the global leaderboards. No items, no luck, only skill. The cleanest, fastest run wins. Someone beats your time? You go again.

Track Editor

Build your own insane tracks with the built-in editor and share them on the Steam Workshop. Race the community's creations and see who sets the top time.

What's Inside

  • Pure time-attack. The clock is your only opponent.

  • Real aerial control. Launches, flight, and landings you fully pilot.

  • Instant restart + complete replays.

  • Global leaderboards + online races.

  • Powerful track editor + Steam Workshop support.

  • Easy to pick up, incredibly deep to master.
short_desc: Super Flying Vroom Vroom is a pure time-attack racer where every ramp launches you into the air. Carry your speed, master your flight, nail the landing, and chase the fastest times on the leaderboards.
